_readme: Reviews shown on reviews.html, copied word for word from the Etsy shop (never edit a review's text). Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_shop.py. Photos are the buyer's own review photos, saved to images/reviews/<id>.jpg (640px). etsyListingId links the review to its product page when the listing is on the site; otherwise 'item' (and optional 'itemUrl') names the item. etsyUrl is where a visitor can read the review on Etsy: the listing's reviews, or the shop's reviews page when the listing is gone. Reviews after the first 'visible' are behind a 'Show more' toggle.

highlight.name: Grace
highlight.text: quality and craftsmanship is so perfect, i can’t believe its handmade!! she responded to my messages quickly and kindly as well! i love it so much. i am going to keep it for my next baby hehe. thank you!!

reviews.name: Abbey
reviews.photoAlt: The crochet Goku inspired baby hat, and the child wearing it for Halloween
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect! The seller was super nice and helpful, and the hat is sooo adorable! It kept its shape all day - the spikes stayed up really well, and I never had to worry about them falling or drooping. My sensory-sensitive son kept it on all day, so it must be comfortable, too!

reviews.name: Yesenia
reviews.photoAlt: Smiling baby in a Gohan costume wearing the crochet four-star hat
reviews.text: This was for my son’s first Halloween costume. I love that it was handmade and fit perfectly. Everyone loved it! This will be a keepsake.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.photoAlt: Gift box with the crochet Luffy inspired straw hat, a onesie and Megan's hand-drawn thank-you card
reviews.text: So adorable! Plus she wrote and drew a handmade thank you letter!! The picture was so cute!! It was the biggest hit out of the whole gift box for the future dad! :)

reviews.name: Sasha
reviews.photoAlt: Mom dressed as Bulma holding her smiling baby in the crochet Trunks inspired set
reviews.text: This was such a cute costume idea and the quality of the product was amazing. Seller was very kind and helped when I accidentally ordered the wrong size and was very prompt with all communications. Very helpful! ☺️

reviews.name: Yoni
reviews.text: Great quality and artistry. This was for our 3 month old, shipping was expedited to help us have a memorable 1st Halloween together. Appreciated the kind gesture.

reviews.name: Paulina
reviews.photoAlt: Baby wearing the crochet Gohan inspired four-star hat
reviews.text: My husband is a huuuuge DB fan, so when he saw this lovely hat, he said: BUY IT! and OMG, the quality of this item is beyond amazing. My baby looks adorable!!!! I got to confess that we had a minor issue with my baby's head being a little bigger for the 0-3M (lol), but Megan was so very kind and helped me get to the correct size! Very few owners tend to have that type of great service, but you definitely went above and beyond with it and I truly appreciate it soooooo MUCH! Highly recommended, definitely a 5 star business! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️✨️

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.photoAlt: A small dog modelling the crochet Gohan inspired four-star hat
reviews.text:
The quality of this hat has exceeded my expectations. It’s sturdy, it’s identical to gohans hat, and it’s sooo adorable! My fiancé and I are dragon ball z lovers, and I’m beyond excited to have our baby wear this when the time comes! 
Megan made the BEST card, and it is something I’m going to hold onto forever since it made me giggle so much! Thank you thank you!!!

reviews.name: Celicia
reviews.photoAlt: Parents in Dragon Ball cosplay at an anime convention with their baby in the crochet Trunks inspired set

There was a bit of a SNAFU with the sizing on the first set I received but the seller was awesome at communicating and meeting my needs. This outfit will definitely go in his memory box.

reviews.name: Chloe
reviews.photoAlt: The crochet Luffy inspired baby straw hat
reviews.text: Exactly as pictured!! So so cute and can’t wait to give it away as a baby shower gift! That dad will LOVE this !!

reviews.name: Zee
reviews.photoAlt: Baby in a Gohan costume wearing the crochet four-star hat

This is really well made and we loved it. There were so many compliments for the hat and his costume. 
The seller was also super understanding and helpful with getting it to us on time. Absolutely the best! I highly recommend this hat and shop. Thanks so much!

reviews.name: Joseph
reviews.photoAlt: The crochet Luffy inspired straw hat with Megan's handwritten care card
reviews.text:
I received the One Piece straw hat this morning, and it came out beautifully! It's a gift for my niece, and I know she's gonna love it! I'm so happy to impart my love of anime with her. Even though her parents know nothing about anime (tragic, I know). Myself, along with other extended aunts and uncles, will fix this lol
And before anyone asks, yes, her parents are cool with this 😂
